game.title: Saving game
game.streak_hint: days in a row below the benchmark
game.rule: How points work: a day without spending scores 10 (5 at the weekend), below a quarter of the benchmark 6, below half 4, up to the benchmark 2. The benchmark is the median day with spending in this period. On top of that comes the month result: if something is left over, you get up to 20 % bonus points — full from 30 % of income.
game.footnote: Only days that are already over are counted. A zero day at the weekend counts half, because card and direct-debit bookings only arrive on the next banking day — an empty Sunday is often just a booking gap. For the same reason the most recent day can still rise.
game.too_early: too early to rate — {n} of {total} days

receipt.pay.title: How was it paid?
receipt.pay.hint: If the receipt turns up as a booking on an account, the payment is proven. If none is found — although the statement for that day has been imported — it was cash; you can file those receipts into a category here, because they appear nowhere in the bank figures. While the statement is still missing, the receipt stays open.

fixed.panel_hint: Only bookings from these categories count. Contracts (same amount on a steady rhythm) appear as their own item; everything else inside a ticked category counts as a monthly average. Categories that are not ticked stay variable, however regular they are.
settings.local_ai.heading: A local model, in one click
settings.local_ai.subtitle: A model on a machine of your own — nothing leaves your house, and nothing costs anything per document. If you already run Ollama, DocuSort finds it by itself.
settings.local_ai.nothing: No model found — neither where DocuSort runs nor on your machine.
settings.local_ai.works: It works — DocuSort asked {model} and got: {answer}. The running classifier switches over on the next restart.
settings.local_ai.saved_not_working: Saved, but DocuSort cannot use the model yet: {answer}
settings.local_ai.setup_help: No Ollama yet? Download the setup, double-click it on the machine the model should run on — not here — and it installs Ollama, pulls a model and fills the address in for you.
settings.local_ai.hints: On first launch macOS asks first (right-click → Open) and Windows shows SmartScreen (“More info” → “Run anyway”). The setup speaks English.
settings.local_ai.warning: If the model runs on a different machine than DocuSort, Ollama has to listen on the network — anyone on that network can then use it, Ollama has no password. The setup asks before it does that.
